I entrusted my dog ​​to this place for grooming this time, but returned with injuries once again.

The biggest issue is that this is not just a simple mistake, but that the same problem keeps recurring.

Previously, the fur on the paw pads was shaved too excessively, causing bleeding and scabs, so I had previously requested caution with photos.

However, this time, the area between the paw pads was scratched again, and my dog ​​is currently in so much discomfort that he keeps licking it.

As you can see from the photos, this is not just grooming; it is clearly an injury.

Even humans feel stinging pain from a slight scratch or tear, so I hope you consider how much more painful it must be for a dog that cannot speak. If you look at the last photo, the grooming style is unnatural, with an unnatural connection between the body and the front legs. It is true that they treat the dog kindly. The groomer is kind, but I am not sure about their skills.

""Also, one thing I appreciate is that when I left the dog for grooming this time due to the previous paw issue, they gave me a liquid ear cleaning solution."

Above all, the problem is that this happened not just once, but twice.

I feel this is not a mistake, but nothing but a lack of basic care and technique.

As a pet owner entrusting my pet to them, this kind of experience is very unsettling and infuriating.

I am leaving this review in the hope that no further harm will occur.

👉 I strongly advise anyone considering using this place to make a careful decision.

I’m posting this as a follow-up to my girlfriend’s recent Google review to provide more context, since we cannot directly reply to the owner’s response.

When we picked up our dog after 3 nights here, the food bag we provided was almost untouched, and he came back noticeably skinnier. He is normally a very quiet dog who has never lost his voice in 10 years, yet he returned hoarse and unable to bark normally. His paws were raw and sensitive, suggesting he had been crated for long periods and clawing to get out. On top of that, his butt was covered in poop, meaning he was forced to relieve himself inside a crate with no clean space to lie down.

We had to take him to the vet the very next day (which ended up costing several hundred dollars) where the red irritation was confirmed to be stress-induced. He also showed obvious trauma afterwards, panicking even in the car ride and at the sight of crates, which historically have never been an issue for him.

When we called the owner to calmly ask what had happened, we weren’t looking for money, we just wanted answers. Instead, the owner paused for long stretches as if scrambling for excuses, brushed off each concern, claimed it was “not a problem” and would “get better,” and even insisted our dog did this to himself. When we finally asked for a refund, given the condition our dog was in and the vet bills we would have to pay, the owner became hostile, raised his voice, and hung up on us.

Reviewing other one-star reviews, this lack of accountability seems to be a pattern. The owner refuses to acknowledge or remedy issues and instead attacks customers who share their experience.

Our dog was not just poorly cared for. He was neglected and traumatized. Please, for your dog’s safety, do not take them here.

I’m so upset about what happened to my dog here. I left him for 3 nights, and when I picked him up, his bark was hoarse and he couldn’t make his normal sounds. The groomer just shrugged and said he barked the whole time and it would “go back to normal.”

Once we got home, I realized his rear was covered in poop, red, and irritated. A vet friend told me it might be an anal gland infection, which broke my heart — he was clearly uncomfortable and in pain.

I called to let the groomer know, hoping for some accountability, but instead he raised his voice at me, denied everything, and even blamed my dog. When I asked for a refund, he snapped, “Fine, go ahead and write the bad review.”

I’ve never had an experience like this before, and I honestly feel guilty for leaving my dog there. The lack of care, empathy, or even a simple apology was shocking. Please don’t risk your dog’s health here — I know I never will again.
Boarding experience was horrible, our dog came back with an infection!

I’m deeply disappointed and angry with this place. Please do not take your dogs here for either grooming or boarding.

I boarded my dog here for 3 nights. When I picked him up, his voice was hoarse and he couldn’t bark normally. The groomer casually said he barked nonstop and that it would “go back to normal.” After leaving, I discovered his butt was covered in poop, red, and irritated. A vet friend told me it could be an anal gland infection, so now I have to take him in.

I called the groomer to let him know, expecting some accountability. Instead, he denied knowing anything, raised his voice, and blamed my dog. When I asked for a refund, he rudely told me, “Fine, go ahead and write the bad review.”

Accidents can happen, but what shocked me most was the lack of care and professionalism. There was no apology, just denial and blame. This is unacceptable. I will never return, and I urge you to take your dog elsewhere—even if it costs more. I thought something like this would never happen to me, but it did. Don’t risk it.
